meta.name: GENOM Zen · Ink-wash editorial system
meta.intent: High-level creative direction derived from Zen / Shui-mo (ink-wash) editorial UI. Use this file to instruct AI and humans when building or refactoring UI in this repository.
meta.referenceMood: Meditative, ethereal, precise, scholarly; premium cultural/lifestyle editorial.
meta.implementationNote: This project maps many tokens to Tailwind: zen-mist, zen-paper, zen-ink, zen-vermilion; fonts font-zenSerif (display), font-zenSans (UI).

philosophy.corePrinciple: The beauty of the void (Ma): intentional emptiness and restraint so content breathes.
philosophy.designFusion: Traditional Eastern ink-wash and seal vocabulary, expressed with modern high-end editorial layout and thin technical line work.
philosophy.voice: Calm authority; never loud. Contrast comes from weight (bold ink vs whisper-thin type), not from color noise.

ink.tailwindAliases: Prefer zen-ink (#1A1A1A) for UI text and borders when pure #000 feels too harsh on long copy.

accent.usage: Seals, stamps, rare primary emphasis, and decisive CTAs only — never as large fields or backgrounds.

dividers.guidance: Prefer 1px borders at low opacity; architectural leader lines thinner than component borders.

semanticRoles.canvas: Near-white; may layer very subtle grain or mist (opacity extremely low).
semanticRoles.secondaryText: Mid grey; extra-light weight, increased tracking.
semanticRoles.interactiveDefault: Ink or grey; hover deepens ink slightly, never rainbow.
semanticRoles.focusRing: Thin ring; may align with vermilion at low opacity for brand consistency.

displaySerif.role: Hero titles, section headers, seal-adjacent display, vertical labels.
displaySerif.character: High-contrast editorial serif; evokes Song-style dignity or high-fashion serif precision.

uiSans.role: Navigation, metadata, captions, buttons, form labels.
uiSans.character: Geometric or neo-grotesk calm; supports Latin + CJK cleanly.
uiSans.weight: Prefer extralight or light for chrome; use semibold sparingly for active states only.

scaleAndRhythm.microLabels: 10px–12px with letter-spacing 0.2em–0.4em (uppercase or all-caps feel acceptable for EN; track Chinese labels modestly).
scaleAndRhythm.display: Large asymmetric titles; avoid compressing line-height; allow single lines to dominate the grid.

verticalText.usage: Decorative section anchors, chapter markers, balance to heavy imagery on opposite side.
verticalText.implementationHint: writing-mode: vertical-rl; combine with font-zenSerif; align to margin edge, not center.

rules: Pair the thinnest UI weights with the darkest ink moments — weight contrast over size contrast.
Wide tracking is part of the brand voice for labels and nav, not optional styling.
Avoid mixing too many type sizes on one screen; usually one hero size + one label size + one body size.

grid.type: Modular editorial grid with intentional asymmetry.
grid.behavior: Content may hug one edge while a second focal (photo + ink graphic) occupies another quadrant; maintain optical balance, not geometric centering.

spacing.principle: If spacing feels enough, increase it once more for hero sections.
spacing.sections: Large vertical gaps between narrative blocks; use Ma (void) as a compositional element.
spacing.inset: Generous page margins; mobile preserves breathing room — shrink typography before removing whitespace.

structure.header: Slim fixed or floating bar; circular seal / mark as anchor; minimal items.
structure.footer: Horizontal row of text-only links, widely spaced, separated by whitespace not heavy rules.
structure.heroPairing: One photographic object plus abstract ink-wash or smoke graphic; allow bleed off-canvas.

photography.treatment: High-contrast studio objects; often isolated or fused into white; no busy lifestyle collage.
photography.integration: Soft edges acceptable where object meets mist background.

inkMotifs.character: Organic splashes, gradients mimicking wash, smoke-like diffusion; never clip art sharp.
inkMotifs.placement: May extend beyond viewport; treat as environmental, not contained cards.

seals.shape: Square or rounded-square stamp with vermilion ground and light glyph.
seals.scale: Small to medium; reads as signature, not logo billboard.

timing.easing: ease-out or custom slow; breath-like, not snappy.
timing.projectConvention: This codebase often uses duration ~2000ms for shell transitions — align new surfaces to feel similarly unhurried.

behaviors: Opacity and gentle translate on scroll reveal.
Hover: slight ink deepen, underline grow, or 1px border clarify — no scale pops.
Focus: visible, thin ring consistent with zen accent.

navigation.primary: Text-first; small cap / tracked labels; active state = ink weight + optional bottom hairline or vermilion accent.
navigation.verticalRail: Optional; single-column icons or characters; same ultra-light typographic voice.
navigation.headerIntegration: Logo/seal cell may share border with sidebar column for a continuous L-shaped frame.

buttons.primary: Solid ink (black or zen-ink) block; tiny uppercase label with extreme tracking; white text.
buttons.secondaryGhost: Transparent with hairline border; hover fills whisper grey wash.
buttons.textLink: Underlined or understroke animation on hover; arrow nudge optional for directional CTAs.
buttons.signatureSeal: Composite: vermilion square (static glyph) + adjacent neutral label rail; hover shifts label surface only.

cardsAndPanels.surfaces: Mostly borderless on mist; if bordered, 1px low-opacity only.
cardsAndPanels.radius: Prefer subtle (e.g. rounded-sm to rounded-2xl), never playful pills unless narrative demands.
cardsAndPanels.shadow: Avoid heavy elevation; prefer flat or single-pixel offset at most.

forms.inputs: Minimal border; light placeholder in muted ink; focus: hairline + slight background lift.
forms.labels: Micro tracked uppercase or light sans above field.

technicalCallouts.description: Dissection / blueprint lines from object to tiny labels.
technicalCallouts.stroke: 0.5–1px ink at low opacity; labels in micro sans; never compete with hero type.

paginationAndProgress.style: Minimal dots or typographic counters (e.g. 01 / 07); light weight, plenty of surrounding space.

modalsAndOverlays.scrim: Soft dark with blur optional; content panel on mist white with hairline frame.
modalsAndOverlays.close: Small circular icon control; stroke icons at 1.5px weight.

listsAndFeeds.density: Comfortable; prefer one column editorial flow or sparse grid; avoid cramped multi-column chips.
listsAndFeeds.separators: Whitespace over rules; rules are hairline if needed.

tablesAndData.guidance: Use sparingly in this aesthetic; if present, ultra-light rules and generous row height.

notifications.guidance: Whisper tone; vermilion only for critical emphasis; avoid saturated system colors except errors.

designPrinciplesForAI: Prioritize Ma (empty space) as a first-class layout ingredient, not leftover margin.
Maintain a monochrome-plus-vermilion discipline: color rarity signals importance.
Use asymmetry: anchor weight (image, ink mass) against a quiet margin with vertical type or a single seal.
Typography hierarchy = weight + tracking + position, not rainbow colors or heavy bold everywhere.
Borders and lines are architectural: thin, low contrast, precise.
Motion should feel like ink settling: slow fades and small translations.
Components should feel editorial and bespoke; avoid generic dashboard widgets without reinterpretation.
When in doubt, reduce chrome and increase spacing before adding new UI elements.
